title: Chal Madine Chalte Hai
roman: Ae Kash Koi Akar Keh De Mere Kano Mein
Chal Tujhko Madine Mein Sarkar Bulate Hain
Dil Ki Hasrat Ko Puri Farmae
Aao Tayba Ko Sath Chalte Hai
Kya Karega Idhar Mang Rakhte Safar
Gar Khushi Chahie To Madine Chalo
Sari Masti Madine Ki Galiyo Mein Hai

Jashn Ham Manate Hai Jalne Vale Jalte Hai

Jashn Ham Manate Hai Jalne Vale Jalte Hai
Naate Ham Sunate Hai Jalne Vale Jalte Hai
Rehmato Ki Chadar Ke Sar Pe Saye Chalte Hai

Naksh Karle Sine Par Nam-e-Sarvar-e-Di Ko
Ye Vo Nam Hai Jis Se Sab Azab Talte Hai
Sirf Sari Duniya Mein Vo Tayba Ki Galiya Hai
Jis Jagah Par Mujh Jaise Khote Sikke Chalte Hai
Zikr-e-Shahe Bat-ha Ko Vird Apna Bana Lijie
Ye Vo Zikr Hai Jis Se Gam Khushi Mein Dhalte Hai
Sach Hai Gair Ka Ehsan Ham Kabhi Nahi Lete
Ae Alim Aqa Ke Ham Tukdo Pe Palte Hai
